---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea for AnatoVision
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
---

## Is your request related to a problem?
A clear description of the problem or gap, e.g. "It's hard to find X because…"

## Describe the solution you'd like
What you want to happen.

## Describe alternatives you've considered
Any alternative solutions or features you've thought about.

## Which part of the roadmap does this fit?
- [ ] Anatomy Explorer
- [ ] Imaging viewers (X-ray / CT / MRI / Ultrasound / PET / Angiography)
- [ ] Cross-sectional / 3D Anatomy
- [ ] Quiz / Flashcards / Study Notes
- [ ] Search / Bookmarks
- [ ] Other / not sure

## Additional context
Anything else — mockups, references, related issues.

---
Note: AnatoVision is free, login-free, and dataset-driven by design (see
the project README). Requests that require accounts, payments, or
non-open datasets are likely out of scope.
